name: When is the best time of year to replace windows for energy savings?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time of year to replace windows for energy savings?

acceptedAnswer.text: While windows can be replaced year-round, mild weather conditions, typically spring or fall, are often ideal. Moderate temperatures ensure sealants and caulking cure properly, which is crucial for maximizing energy efficiency. Replacing windows during extreme heat or cold can affect material expansion and contraction, potentially compromising the seal. Scheduling during off-peak seasons might also offer more flexibility in contractor availability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Spring or fall are generally best for window replacement, as mild temperatures allow sealants to cure properly, maximizing energy efficiency.
